base.rule: Add file presentation only; all prior messages and fixtures remain unchanged.

row: Owner 2026-11-11: file chips and passive readers; no producer activation

amendments.change: the owner uses public m.read and public typing by default, controlled by one account privacy setting; off uses m.read.private and no public typing; an agent receipt in a group targets only a message addressed to or admitted by that agent, and cumulative receipts never reveal unrelated group reading

one redacted m.notice rich reply in the owner private chat carries io.atum.progress and is edited in place; groups never receive it; edits are at least 3000 ms apart, at most 48 per turn, at most 1000 characters, and never duplicate the final answer

progress_shown, progress_edited and progress_settled keep client_turn working; only the final m.text answer or a terminal status ends what the owner is owed; progress never suppresses the no-reply banner and never becomes the roster preview
message.interim and todo tool completion update the same line; after 180000 ms without new interim text a heartbeat may say only that work continues and elapsed minutes, with no tool names

ordinary Mac-routed steps post no separate wait notice; after 5000 ms they may update the progress line with the selected Mac; unreachable and Touch ID waits are published only after a real Mac is selected, name that Mac, resume on reconnect or approval, and an unreachable follow-up expires after 7200000 ms
the progress root remains after the answer collapsed to its final line, edits are drained before the final answer, and queued or late edits are dropped after settlement

supersedes A6: the progress line is transient. It is redacted by its publisher once the turn has settled and drained, and a client hides any progress line (and any retired fixed "waiting/waited for your Mac" status line) whose turn has ended before the redaction lands, and renders no tombstone for a redacted agent message; it never notifies, never reads edited and never becomes the roster preview

tool activity, the todo list and every wait (a slow Mac step, an unreachable Mac before it is an outcome, Touch ID) share the one progress line; an answered wait returns the line to its previous text rather than saying it waited

the agent first interim remark of a turn is a real m.text message marked io.atum.interim:true (the acknowledgement); later remarks are also real messages, at most one per 20000 ms, redacted text only, dropped when they duplicate the answer; interim messages are never the answer and never suppress the no-reply banner

typing is on from the moment the agent takes a message until its answer or a terminal status, renewed every 20000 ms inside the 30000 ms Matrix timeout, and stays on while a Mac does a step; it pauses only while the agent waits for the person

only a real outcome persists as a notice: an unreachable Mac with the way out, out of Protons, trial ended, a routine that could not run, and the interrupted-work verification; text that only says the agent is working, waiting or waited is transient

content may carry an optional closed io.atum.presentation descriptor {version:1, code, args}; the wire profile stays atum.agent-turns/1.3 with the strict marker unchanged so 1.3 and 1.4 content readers ignore the top-level extension and keep rendering body; an absent descriptor, an unknown version or code, malformed or oversized args, or a code that does not pair with the marker kind and phase means: render body

the descriptor codes are tool_activity {activity: web|read|write|run|delegate|look|draw}, todo_progress {done,total}, first_learning {}, heartbeat {elapsed_minutes}, device_wait {} and touch_id {} (the Mac is the marker device); the descriptor never carries a raw tool name, argument, result, identifier or text the agent or a person wrote, and the agent narration and todo item text have no key and stay authored text

io.atum.result.status covers every status code of atum.agent-home/1.9 on a notice, plus device_unreachable, with top-level io.atum.result_details (devices, routine_title, attachment, resume); an answer that ends with an appended warning carries io.atum.result_warning {version:1, from}, the scalar offset of the "\n\n" that starts the warning, so a client keeps the answer byte for byte and may replace only the warning
a scheduled or standing line that is not a turn outcome carries io.atum.status {version:1, code, details?} and never io.atum.result, which old clients read as an answer marker

progress_to_owner_room.description: One redacted progress notice in the agent owner private chat. It is presentation, never an outcome or execution authority.

conformance.description: Worked policy and state-machine examples; not a wire payload.

interim_to_owner_room.description: An interim remark from the agent in its private chat with the owner: an ordinary agent message that is not the answer.

result_status_to_room.description: A terminal or standing outcome notice from the agent in a room: a status code and bounded details beside a readable body. The body stays the sender-language fallback; a client words the code in its own language.

answer_to_room.description: An answer from the agent whose text ends with an appended localized warning (saved to Drive, saved as a copy, not confirmed, memory not saved). `io.atum.result_warning.from` separates the answer from the warning.

scheduled_status_to_room.description: A scheduled or standing line from the agent that is not the outcome of a turn (the daily-allowance heads-up, a missed reminder, a routine that did not finish). It never carries io.atum.result, so no client reads it as an answer.

company_presentation_to_room.description: Admitted public identity only. Recheck authority on every send/edit/redact; exact m.thread root, never room timeline fallback.

file_presentation_to_room.description: Encrypted room content only. Current bound sender and exact owner/company/audience/room/root/task/invocation; file keys are never capabilities.
